RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 55

An all-male panel selecting a less traditionally credentialed male candidate can reflect unconscious affinity bias, though director-level appointments often heavily weight political acumen and stakeholder management over technical licenses. 

Raising the panel's gender composition directly with the municipality right now is premature and likely to provoke defensiveness. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive debrief feedback. If the response remains evasive or reveals subjective, inconsistent criteria, consult an employment lawyer before taking further action. While an all-male panel alone is not legal proof of discrimination, it serves as important context if paired with procedural irregularities and demonstrable qualification disparities.
